## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical rollout orchestration, data residency enforcement, and observability during production deployments using Google-native tools.

## Key Concepts
- Cloud Deploy with per-region traffic controls
- Artifact Registry and Cloud Run v2 deployments
- Region-scoped Pub/Sub topics and regional BigQuery sinks for data residency
- Per-tenant metrics (latency, errors) and alerting
- Rollback by traffic shift and residency enforcement

## Code Example
```yaml
# deploy.yaml (conceptual)
delivery:
  pipelines:
  - name: regional-rollout
    targets:
      - us-central1
      - europe-west1
      - asia-northeast1
    phases:
      - canary: 10%
      - stable: 100%
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you validate residency constraints during rollouts?
- What failure modes would trigger automatic rollback and how would you test them?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests progressive delivery orchestration using Google-native tools across multi-region GKE, including per-region traffic steering, automated rollback, and monitoring-driven gates.

## Key Concepts
- Cloud Deploy multi-region progressive delivery
- GKE traffic shaping and global HTTP(S) Load Balancer integration

- Cloud Monitoring alerting for latency and error thresholds
- IAM least privilege for deploy automation

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example Cloud Deploy pipeline sketch (simplified)
apiVersion: deploy.config.k8s.io/v1
kind: DeliveryConfig
metadata:
  name: prod
releases:
- name: v3-release
  project: my-gcp-project
  region: us-central1,us-west1
  remainPaused: false
  images:
  - gcr.io/my-project/my-service:v3
  strategies:
  - Canary:

      region:
        - us-central1
        - us-west1
      duration: 40m
      onFailure:
        rollbackTo: v2
```

Per-tenant IAM uses dedicated service accounts with roles/run.invoker for least-privilege access. VPC Service Controls perimeters restrict data exfiltration and enforce data residency. Zero-downtime rollout uses Cloud Deploy for progressive traffic shifting between revisions with configurable percentage-based splitting. Per-tenant SLI monitoring with Cloud Monitoring alerting triggers Cloud Deploy rollback automatically when thresholds are breached. Automated onboarding uses Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) to provision Pub/Sub topics and Dataflow flex templates per tenant, ensuring data plane isolation. The key Google-native tools are: Cloud Run (compute), Cloud CDN + Global HTTP(S) Load Balancer (ingress/CDN), VPC Service Controls (security perimeter), Cloud Deploy (CD pipeline), Cloud Monitoring + Alerting (observability), Terraform (IaC), Pub/Sub (eventing), and Dataflow (data processing).
